_note: Add one object to notices for each homepage message. Only one message is displayed at a time; visitors can swipe or use the arrow controls to see the others. carousel.autoPlay enables automatic swapping and carousel.intervalSeconds sets the delay from 3 to 30 seconds. enabled controls whether a message can appear. Priority controls order and color: low is green, medium is blue, important is amber, and critical is red. startDate and endDate are optional YYYY-MM-DD dates evaluated in Myanmar time. Keep every id unique and change it when publishing a replacement notice so previous dismissals do not hide the new message.
